headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google's VP hinted at a higher price for the upcoming Pixel 11. The increase is linked to RAM supply issues. AI data centers are driving demand for components.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Oli Freke, a musician and journalist, is known for his synth history expertise. He has published works on music theory and synthesizer evolution. Despite his musical focus, he prioritizes investing in a quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering's grooveboxes blend synthesizers, loopers, and effects. These devices enable real-time song creation with distinctive designs. A wide range of their products are currently discounted by 30 percent.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has filed a lawsuit against Amazon. Amazon is accused of illegally poaching employees, including a senior marketing VP. Warner Bros. claims Amazon is 'riding on the coattails' of Hollywood mainstays.

headline: Kevin Feige Pushes Back at Criticisms That Dr. Doom Hasn't Had Thanos-Level Buildup
summary: Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige addressed criticism regarding Dr. Doom's buildup. Fans argue Doom lacks the extensive setup Thanos received. Feige is defending the character's potential as the MCU's next big villain.

headline: Winston Duke Confirms That Yes, He Really Did Improvise That Iconic Line In Black Panther
summary: Winston Duke confirmed he improvised a memorable line in Black Panther. The line became one of the film's most iconic and humorous moments. His spontaneous delivery added a unique charm to the character.

headline: 'I Would Stay at That Haunted Inn' — Widow's Bay Cast and Crew Are Just as Attached to the Island as the Rest of Us | Comic Con 2026
summary: The cast and crew of Apple TV's 'Widow's Bay' appeared at Comic-Con 2026. They reacted to the show's breakout success during their first Hall H panel. The team expressed deep affection for the series' fictional island setting.

headline: The 4 Biggest Mysteries From Marvel's Comic-Con Panel | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel revealed significant new mysteries. Questions arose about T'Challa's adult son and Ryan Reynolds' Ghost Rider role. Fans are speculating about the implications for Deadpool's future.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Prime Minister Burnham stated he's ready to challenge Trump when necessary. He emphasized the importance of defending Britain's national interest. Burnham noted a good initial conversation with the US president.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: PM Andy Burnham ruled out an early general election in a BBC interview. He affirmed his commitment to honor the current manifesto voters supported. Burnham stated his focus remains on delivering the mandate given.

headline: France battles fire 'whirlwinds' as another 55,000 evacuated
summary: France is combating intense wildfires, including dangerous fire 'whirlwinds'. An additional 55,000 people have been evacuated due to the blazes. Over 340,000 have now fled wildfires across France and Spain.

headline: Iran's 'sabre-rattling' should not intimidate UK, Wes Streeting says
summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting warned Iran against intimidating the UK. He stated Britain is prepared to respond to any attacks from Iran. Streeting affirmed the UK's readiness to defend itself and its allies.
